name: Nieragus
backstory: Child of Nierius and Magus in Salthos Cruzados; raised alongside walks the transit route's Salthos stretch at dawn..., having heard about Birth Of Darnakus.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Heard that Darius and Niemus now have a child, Darnus.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Nakus and Prince Doran now have a child, Dorakus.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Fenserika and Darius now have a child, Darika.
Had a child with Niemoran, named Nieragan.
Had a child with Dorakus, named Nieradus.
Heard that Fenserika and Niekus now have a child, Fenekus.
Heard that Darnakus and Niemoran now have a child, Niemornak.
Heard that Niekus and Nieragan now have a child, Nierakus.

criterion.standard: measures a life by whether CONFLICT-03 is still remembered rightly
criterion.wasted_life: forgetting what CONFLICT-03 actually meant, the way most people already have

routines.routine_actions: opens the temple each dawn, keeps the old rites going out of duty more than certainty, and quietly notes down which pilgrim stories don't match
opens the temple each dawn, keeps the old rites going out of duty more than certainty, and quietly notes down which pilgrim stories don't match

arc.premise: Nieragus has stopped trying to work out from pilgrims' scattered questions whether CONFLICT-03 really happened the way either house tells it, and started raising a joint marker at the temple - both houses' accounts carved side by side, settled by standing together rather than by proof.
